name: final-i-s-split-fix
note: Critic ref-0191 fix-up of bin A (S split p23/p45 GLUE ran at FT_CONC=3): per mixture, reuse bin A's zero-shot + guard and its 6 concurrent tasks; rerun multirc sequentially for both members (m0 seed 42, m1 seed 43) and rebuild _ens2; spot check: p23 member 0 rte seed 42 rerun sequentially must be sha256-identical to bin A's concurrent copy (spot_identity_*.txt), else GLUE_INCOMPLETE_mixS_p23_ens2 and the whole bin reruns sequentially (option b). Same member URIs as bin A (fill __URI_A_*__); __BINA_OUT__ = bin A's synced out dir. Runs on project-b after bin A closes. Concurrent multirc is reported nowhere. Readout uses this OUT alone for mixS_p23/p45 (it carries the copied zero-shot + guard).

jobs.name: glue_fix_S_split_p23
jobs.cmd: FT_PARALLEL=0 GLUE_ENS=2 DEV_BPW=0 GLUE_RERUN=multirc GLUE_SPOT=m0:rte GLUE_PREV=__BINA_OUT__/score_mix_S_split_p23 HF_URI='__URI_A_p23_m0__ __URI_A_p23_m1__' HF_NAME=mixS_p23 bash babylm/jobs/vm_job.sh score_mix out/glue_fix_S_split_p23
